items.title: New dollar declaration rule squeezes banks, travellers
items.description: Md Zakir Hossain returned to Bangladesh from Thailand on November 11, unaware of a new Bangladesh Bank rule requiring returning passengers to declare their foreign currency cash at the airport.

items.title: Germany pledges €246m in fresh funds
items.description: Germany has committed up to €246 million in fresh development cooperation funds for Bangladesh, taking its total commitments since the 2024 intergovernmental negotiations to €402 million, or around Tk 5,507 crore.

items.title: Resolve economic issues, end corruption: Hossain Zillur
items.description: Economist Hossain Zillur Rahman yesterday urged the government to resolve economic challenges while stopping corruption and harassment so entrepreneurs can expand their businesses.

items.title: BB expands farm credit to climate-smart agriculture
items.description: Bangladesh Bank (BB) has revised its agricultural and rural credit policy for fiscal 2026-27, bringing precision farming, climate-smart agriculture and agricultural value chains under its scope.
